people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
translations.bsb: The Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword.
translations.kjv: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain
